column1: Jacob Wilson leads the slate with a strong hit probability and a favorable home matchup against Patrick Sandoval, who has allowed a high rate of hits to righties this season. Ceddanne Rafaela also offers steady reliability near the top of Boston’s order and benefits from a similar platoon edge. Yandy Diaz and Otto Lopez are both consistent options with leadoff roles and soft matchups, but Wilson’s combination of opportunity and park boost stands out for Beat The Streak players.
